svg.title: India map outline
svg.desc: India state and union territory boundaries simplified for a silhouette map.
svg.metadata: Derived from geoBoundaries IND ADM1 data, boundary source DataMeet India community and Election Commission of India, CC BY 2.5 IN. Source: https://www.geoboundaries.org/api/current/gbOpen/IND/ADM1/ . Geometry simplified for this illustration.
